brief.summary: Relaxed, intelligent classics with knitwear as the hero: a fine sweater or cardigan over a slip skirt, wide-leg trousers or straight jeans, or a long knit column dress. Black, navy, camel and white, tonal and easy, lifted by gold hardware, one jewel-coloured accent and a soft leather bag; low heels, loafers or ankle boots.
signatures: crew-neck cashmere sweater over a sheer or satin midi slip skirt
navy knit with a blazer over the shoulders and white wide-leg trousers
black cardigan with gold buttons and wide-leg trousers
turtleneck knit maxi dress with block-heel ankle boots
oversized checked wool shirt-jacket with straight jeans
soft leather tote or bucket bag
gold cuff, statement earrings, long pendant necklace
